name: Malformed Nginx Site Configuration Diagnosis and Fix
description: Nginx fails to start due to a missing semicolon or broken directive in site configuration.
symptom: systemctl restart nginx fails with exit status 1
untrusted_logs:
nginx: [emerg] invalid number of arguments in 'listen' directive in /etc/nginx/sites-available/default:2
nginx: configuration file /etc/nginx/nginx.conf test failed
